name: Surreal Epic
description: A cinematic LoRA that fuses hyper-realistic photography with dream-logic surrealism. Impossible alien megastructures, blood-red rivers under biomechanical tripods, medieval knights facing UFOs, glowing equations floating in twilight skies, and god-ray volcanoes mirrored in obsidian lakes and more. Use your imagination. Best strength: 0.3-0.6: subtle mood + epic lighting + surreal color grading, works as refiner for base model 0.7-1: full invasion of the impossible (floating monoliths, biomechanical skies, alien geometry, anachronistic tech etc) I recommend this clip: Quants here: https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/Josiefied-Qwen3-4B-abliterated-v2-GGUF/tree/main
